'''Daimanate Sith troopers''' were the main infantry of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]]'s principality, the [[Daimanate]]. They were used as a ''de facto'' police force and military during the [[Republic Dark Age]] in the late [[New Sith Wars]], and wore a set of steel-plated full body armor matching that used by [[Gloom Walkers|later]] [[Sith trooper (New Sith Wars)|Sith troopers]] under the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]]. They saw action during the [[Second Charge Matrica]] including the [[Chelloan affair|Chelloan]] and [[Aquilaris campaign]]s. By [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], the organization had been weakened by [[Operation Deluge]]&mdash;a black operation by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grace Command]] to inundate Sith-controlled space with the addictive [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Deluge]]. In response, Daiman ordered the purging of half of his military forces. The [[Odionate]] agent [[Claimer]] [[Wayman]] had also infiltrated the corps on [[Tergamenion]], where he succeeded in recruiting a disguised [[Kerra Holt]] into Odion's elite [[Novitiate]]s.
